mapper.sql: SELECT c.id AS consultationId, a.appointment_code AS appointmentCode, a.token_number AS tokenNumber, u.full_name AS patientName, p.patient_code AS patientCode, doc.full_name AS doctorName, dept.dept_name AS departmentName, c.completed_at AS completedAt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM prescription_items pi WHERE pi.consultation_id = c.id) AS itemCount, c.dispense_status AS dispenseStatus FROM consultations c JOIN appointments a ON a.id = c.appointment_id JOIN patients p ON p.id = c.patient_id JOIN users u ON u.id = p.user_id JOIN doctors doc ON doc.id = c.doctor_id JOIN departments dept ON dept.id = doc.department_id
mapper.select: WHERE c.status = 'COMPLETED' AND c.dispense_status = 'PENDING' AND DATE(c.completed_at) = #{date} ORDER BY c.completed_at ASC

WHERE c.dispense_status IN ('PENDING','DISPENSED') AND c.completed_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND (p.patient_code = #{q} OR u.phone = #{q} OR a.appointment_code = #{q}) ORDER BY c.completed_at DESC

SELECT c.id AS consultationId, u.full_name AS patientName, p.patient_code AS patientCode, TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, p.date_of_birth, CURDATE()) AS age, p.gender AS gender, doc.full_name AS doctorName, a.appointment_date AS consultationDate, c.diagnosis AS diagnosis, c.follow_up_date AS followUpDate, c.dispense_status AS dispenseStatus, c.dispensed_at AS dispensedAt, dispenser.full_name AS dispensedByName, c.dispense_remarks AS dispenseRemarks FROM consultations c JOIN appointments a ON a.id = c.appointment_id JOIN patients p ON p.id = c.patient_id JOIN users u ON u.id = p.user_id JOIN doctors doc ON doc.id = c.doctor_id LEFT JOIN users dispenser ON dispenser.id = c.dispensed_by WHERE c.id = #{consultationId}
